messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Rescue of the Broken City

scenes.caption: Mara plots a course into the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept ridge at dusk overlooking a shattered royal skyline; an ink-stained coat flaps as a brass compass spins over a hand-drawn map.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of the road ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A small camp under a leaning road sign; the lamp's single flame-eye blazes, casting long warning shadows across Mara's map.

scenes.caption: The tin fox sniffs the broken gate.
scenes.visual_description: A clockwork fox with blue glass eyes peers through the bent bars of an enormous castle gate, key-wind tail ticking softly.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver arrives through a cracked window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps out of a broken pane as if from water, coat shimmering with reflected city lights.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector blocking the way.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official snores at a toll booth, ledger book under his cheek, stamped papers fluttering from his sleeves in the wind.

scenes.caption: The lamp whispers a route past the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A spiraling black tower looms; the oracle lamp glows green near a cracked alley, beckoning the team away from the obvious path.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts an armored patrol.
scenes.visual_description: From behind a fallen royal banner, the clockwork fox watches metal-booted shapes march down a rubble-strewn boulevard.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips through a shop window.
scenes.visual_description: The diver dives headfirst into a tall pane of glass, body rippling like water as the helmet glints with reflected torchlight.

scenes.caption: Mara decodes a torn royal banner.
scenes.visual_description: Beneath a half-burned banner, Mara traces faded heraldry with inky fingers while the tin fox shines lamplight on the cloth.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp names the magic door.
scenes.visual_description: A great brass door etched with runes pulses faintly; the lamp's eye reflects in every glyph as Mara raises her compass.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver pulls the captive from a mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a candle-lit chamber, the diver hauls the sleeping tax collector from a tall standing mirror, water-light dripping off both of them.

scenes.caption: The tax collector refuses to wake up.
scenes.visual_description: Slumped against a column, the official snores while stamped forms drift around him; Mara tugs his sleeve in exasperation.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox sets off a distant alarm bell.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox yanks a frayed rope on a rooftop, sending a cracked bell swinging above the smoldering rooftops as a diversion.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns of a collapsing arch.
scenes.visual_description: Stones grind overhead in a colonnade; the lamp's flame-eye flares red as the diver shields the snoring official with a reflective coat.

scenes.caption: Mara redraws the map on the run.
scenes.visual_description: Sprinting through a flooded plaza, Mara sketches frantically on damp parchment while the tin fox bounds ahead through puddled reflections.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver opens a window across the river.
scenes.visual_description: At the foot of a ruined keep, the diver presses both palms to a glowing pane that ripples like a vertical pond, revealing a far bridge.

scenes.caption: The team races onto the long bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow stone bridge stretches over a chasm of mist; Mara, the tin fox, and the diver carry the sleeping official as the lamp lights the way.

scenes.caption: They look back at the broken city, free.
scenes.visual_description: On the far cliff at dawn, the rescuers stand silhouetted against pale sky; the tax collector finally blinks awake as the lamp's eye dims to a gentle glow.
